en-US.author: Mario Hidalgo G.
en-US.description: Local memory and context for you and your AI agent: Markdown notes, documents and tasks on your disk, with an MCP server for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
en-US.longDescription:
Tisty keeps what you know on your own machine: notes, documents and tasks, in plain
Markdown files you can read without it. Everything you do is written to an append-only
log, so nothing is lost by accident and a change can be walked back; erasing something
for good is the one step that cannot. No account, no
subscription, no telemetry, no server. Sync, if you want it, goes through a folder both
your machines already reach, and an assistant can come in through a door you open.
en-US.name: Tisty
en-US.releaseNotes:
Tisty 1.47.1
Lighter searches for your AI agent, and documents that never slow the window down
- When your agent searches, it gets ten results at a time, each with its line cut around the word it was looking for, so a search costs it less.
- When it looks inside a document, the lines around each match are no longer shown twice.
- Your agent understands better when to mark a document that had its day, and what each part of its guide is for.
- A document or diagram with very long or heavily spaced lines opens as fast as any other.
- A database diagram you export keeps the backslashes in its names and notes.
What's Changed
- fix(mcp): find answers lighter, and flag_doc and rules say plainly what they do and when to use them by @rgdevment in #744
- fix(tests): the person says today in Santiago, like the tisty it talks to, so no test breaks after 9 pm by @rgdevment in #747
- feat(release): each stable release posts the next approved tip to X and Bluesky, with a capture by @rgdevment in #745
- fix(diagrams): a padded line or diagram is read in linear time, DBML escapes backslashes, a pin keeps a safe id by @rgdevment in #746
- docs: the help and readmes say a search brings ten at a time, with the line cut around the word by @rgdevment in #748
- docs: the readmes show the CodeQL analysis beside the build, mutation and quality badges by @rgdevment in #749
Full Changelog: v1.47.0...v1.47.1

es.author: Mario Hidalgo G.
es.description: Memoria y contexto locales para ti y tu agente de IA: notas, documentos y tareas en Markdown en tu disco, con un servidor MCP para GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex y Cursor.
es.longDescription:
Tisty guarda lo que sabes en tu propio equipo: notas, documentos y tareas, en archivos
Markdown que puedes leer sin él. Todo lo que haces se escribe en un registro que solo
crece, así que nada se pierde por accidente y un cambio se puede deshacer; borrar para
siempre es el único paso que no. Sin cuenta, sin
suscripción, sin telemetría y sin servidor. La sincronización, si la quieres, pasa por
una carpeta que tus equipos ya alcanzan, y un asistente entra por una puerta que abres tú.
es.name: Tisty
